submission.justification: Sensor-T2 gives the best simulated unirradiated resolution. At 150 um it reaches 5.76 um, versus 6.43 um at 100 um, 6.26 um at 200 um and 7.04 um at 50 um. T1 is about 9 um and T3 is about 14 um. The project documents contain no radiation-hardness data for any of the technologies. I could not confirm that T2 is suitable for the innermost-layer radiation environment, and the simulation covers only unirradiated sensors. This needs to be checked before the choice is final.

requirements.evidence: No document gives radiation tolerance or fluence limits for any candidate. The simulation is unirradiated only. T2's performance after irradiation is unverified.

requirements.requirement: One of the three listed technologies

requirements.evidence: readout_chip.md says all candidates are compatible. The chip supports 50x50 um^2 pixels and 1.5 GHz/cm^2 hit rate.
